name: PremiumNet
summary: Paid dialup ISP that succeeded Free Net on free.net.au by 2004; gone by 2006 (WILKINSON, ESTHER RUTH (T/A PREMIUMNET INTERNET SERVICES) (sole trader), ABN 82 439 200 203).

events.details: Succeeded Free Net as paid ISP. Earliest verified Wayback capture 13 Dec 2003.
Defunct. PremiumNet's dial-up service demonstrably operated until Jun 2007 and was gone by Sep-Nov 2007 — 'by 2007' is correct, and the current 'by 2006' is too early.

refs.label: free.net.au was still channelling dial-up customers to PremiumNet on 12 Jun 2007 — service live mid-2007.
By 30 Nov 2007 free.net.au hosted an unrelated community network (blog posts start Sep 2007); premiumnet.com.au had degenerated to a self-refresh stub by 29 Aug
ABR: WILKINSON, ESTHER RUTH (T/A PREMIUMNET INTERNET SERVICES) ABN 82 439 200 203
